entries.title: Numbers 28:2
segments:
In their due season; according to the will of God, heretofore or hereafter made known. 
 
No engagements for this world should induce us to neglect the ordinances of religion, or to fail to observe, at the proper time, the divinely appointed means of grace.

entries.title: Numbers 28:9
segments: While it is our duty daily to read the Scriptures and pray, as individuals and families, we should on the Sabbath give special attention to these duties, and also worship God in public with the assembly of his people.

entries.title: Numbers 28:11
segments:
Months; these began with each new moon. 
 
The Lord has appointed the sun and moon for seasons; and the beginning of every day, month, and year, should remind us of our obligations to him, and lead us to devote ourselves anew to his service.

entries.title: Numbers 28:13
segments: A several tenth-deal; one for each lamb.

entries.title: Numbers 28:16
segments: In all our religious exercises we should have reference to the atonement of Christ, and place our reliance on him and what he has done for acceptance with God.

entries.title: Numbers 28:26
segments: After your weeks; after seven weeks from the second day of the passover, when the feast of weeks, or Pentecost, was celebrated.
